subject: trophy room
fact: The trophy room contains only mangy pelts, stuffed heads, and shattered antlers; some of the trophies are the heads of dwarves, humans, and elves, labeled 'Enemies of the temple.'
source_quote: Zinia, who enters the room, looks more carefully and realizes that some of the trophies are the heads of dwarves, humans, and elves — 'Enemies of the temple,' he mutters.

subject: majordomo's domicile
fact: The domicile of the majordomo is stripped of anything valuable.
source_quote: The next door on the southern wall opens into the domicile of the majordomo of the castle. Zephyr sighs; it’s stripped of anything valuable.

subject: barracks room
fact: The westernmost room at the end of the hallway was once a barracks for castle guards, evidenced by the remains of cots and plain wooden chests; the guards were undoubtedly human.
source_quote: From there, Zephyr opens the westernmost door, where the hallway ends. Much like the other parts of the castle, this room is partially collapsed. The remains of cots and plain wooden chests convince the rogue that this was once a barracks room for castle guards—undoubtedly the human sort.

subject: intact chest
fact: An intact chest sits at the south end of the barracks room; it was used as a lure by a giant lizard, which died as a result.
source_quote: Zephyr notices an intact chest at the south end of the room. As he approaches it, he notices a giant lizard just in time. The lizard was using the chest as a lure. This time, the poor creature died.

subject: stairway room
fact: The room beyond the last door in the hallway contains a stairway leading down.
source_quote: Sequoia leads the group past the last door in the hallway and into a room with a stairway leading down.

subject: swarm of rats
fact: A swarm of rats occupies the stairway room; they are quickly killed by the group.
source_quote: It also has a swarm of rats. Rats that are quickly killed.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer suggests finishing the exploration of the ruins of the moathouse to avoid nasty surprises following the group.
source_quote: Calmer turns to the group, 'I suggest we finish exploring the ruins of the moathouse. Don’t want any nasty surprises to follow us.'

subject: wrecked great hall
fact: The great hall is wrecked and crossed by the group as they move toward the southern passageway.
source_quote: Sequoia agrees. They cross the wrecked great hall and head down the southern passageway, which is 70 feet long and has three doors. The hallway runs north-south.

subject: southern passageway
fact: The southern passageway is 70 feet long, runs north-south, and has three doors.
source_quote: Sequoia agrees. They cross the wrecked great hall and head down the southern passageway, which is 70 feet long and has three doors. The hallway runs north-south.

subject: conference room
fact: The first door in the southern passageway opens into an old conference room; the rogue sniffs and shuts the door, declaring nothing to be found.
source_quote: The first door the rogue opens reveals an old conference room chamber. He sniffs and shuts the door, 'Nothing to be found.'

subject: bed chamber
fact: The second door on the western wall opens into a bed chamber that once belonged to a lowly official.
source_quote: Sequoia mutters, 'And for door number two,' as he opens the next door on the western wall. And in this chamber, he finds what must have been a bed chamber for some lowly official.

subject: salon
fact: Across the hallway, the third door opens into a salon; though in shambles and missing items, what remains appears valuable — but the treasures turned out to be worthless. The room is speculated to have been a meeting salon.
source_quote: Across the hallway, he sees another door and excitedly opens it. He looks inside, and although the room is in shambles and things are missing, whatever remains still appears valuable. He enters carefully, and as he picks up the treasures, he realizes they are worthless. He looks around and mutters, 'A salon for meetings?'

subject: end chamber
fact: The large chamber at the end of the hallway is empty of valuables but contains a giant poisonous snake that attempts to strike and fails; it is soon killed, like other nuisance monsters the group has faced.
source_quote: Leaving the salon and reentering the hallway, he walks into the large chamber at the end of the hallway. Much like other parts of the moathouse, this room is empty of anything valuable. Unlike other rooms, this room has a giant poisonous snake that attempts to strike. It fails. Soon, like the other nuisance monsters the group has faced, it is dead.
